answer: Our exchange policy covers the same item in a different size or color, at no cost. Full-price items can be exchanged within 30 days, and sale items within 14 days. FINAL SALE items cannot be exchanged. Exchanges can be made in store or online. If you want a different style, I can explain your return options. For a stock check or help with a specific order, contact our store team at ny@kestrelrow.example or (212) 555-0147.
